statement: Let B be a unital C∗-algebra. Suppose that a1, a2 ∈ B are orthogonal positive contractions with a1 = v∗v, a2 = vv∗ for some v ∈ B, and that, for some ε > 0, 1B − a1 − a2 ≾ (a1 − ε)+. Then there is a unital ∗-homomorphism I(2, 3) → B.
